references.text: Pharaoh confesses his sin and asks Moses to pray to the Lord, a similar pattern where the people or their leader admits sin and requests intercession.
Aaron confesses sin and asks Moses to pray for Miriam. Moses intercedes for the people, following the same pattern as in Numbers 21:7.
The people cry out to Moses, and he prays to the Lord. This shows Moses' role as an intercessor between the people and God.
The people confess: 'We have sinned.' The same confession of sin as in Numbers 21:7.
Moses intercedes for the people after their sin with the golden calf. This illustrates Moses' role as a mediator.
The people ask Samuel to pray to the Lord on their behalf. The same pattern of intercession through God's servant.
Job is asked to pray for his friends, and the Lord hears his intercession. This demonstrates the power of prayer.
King Hezekiah asks Isaiah to pray for the people. A similar request for intercession from a servant of God.
Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another. The same principle of confession and intercession.
If anyone sees their brother sin, they should pray, and God will give them life. Intercession for sinners.
